leadText: Geraldo (Japanese: ヒロカズ Hirokazu) is a minor recurring character in .
plainText:
Geraldo (Japanese: ヒロカズ Hirokazu) is a minor recurring character in .

==History==
Geraldo debuted in Jostling for the Junior Cup!, where he participated in the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup. His first opponent was Cassie, whom he defeated, advancing himself to the next round. He appeared again in Battling Authority Once Again!, where he battled in the second round and lost. Geraldo made a cameo appearance in Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!, where he lined up with all the other competitors in front of Alder, Cynthia, Caitlin, and Freddy O'Martian.

In Curtain Up, Unova League!, Geraldo competed in the Vertress Conference. In Mission: Defeat Your Rival!, he appeared on the screen showing the match-ups for the second round of the Conference, which indicated that he had made it through the first round. When the screens showed the match-ups for the last sixteen in Lost at the League!, Geraldo did not appear on it, which meant that he had lost either in the second round or the third round. In A Unova League Evolution!, he appeared once again during the closing ceremonies of the Vertress Conference.

==Pokémon==
 
 

Geraldo has at least one other Pokémon, as he participated in the second round of the Vertress Conference which requires a 2 vs 2 Single Battle

==Achievements==
===Badges obtained===
This listing is of the Badges Geraldo has obtained in the Unova region:
At least eight Badges (prior to Curtain Up, Unova League!)

===Pokémon League===
Geraldo has competed in the following Pokémon League Conferences:
Vertress Conference - Top 32 / Top 64 (Lost at the League!)

===Pokémon competitions===
Geraldo has competed in the following :
Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup - Top 8 (Battling Authority Once Again!)
